data.narrative:
Performance Drone Works is a Series B-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $110M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech.

Two primary triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $110M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $209M. Peer-median analysis examines 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B; the median across this set is $1.1B. The disparity between these methods reflects meaningful variance in peer valuations and the relative early stage of the target company relative to some peer achievements.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $178M to $1.3B, with a median of $667M. The wide range reflects two principal uncertainties: the heterogeneity of peer valuation outcomes at Series B in Defense & Security, where valuations span a 10x spread, and limited visibility into Performance Drone Works' specific revenue, profitability, or technology differentiation relative to peers. Further tightening would require additional data on comparable transaction multiples or target-specific unit economics.
